description: The first-time example CPU novacore with the real pinned OpenTitan uart as a TL-UL MMIO target. The uart's whole bus is two packed struct ports (tl_h2d_t/tl_d2h_t), so this is the composition that exercises member-wise struct-port binding, rendering and audit on a real IP. The CPU is an example design because every real CPU profile in this checkout (ibex, cva6) vendors its own lowRISC prim_* packages, and Verilator refuses to elaborate two different declarations of the same package in one compilation (MODDUP): a real CPU plus OpenTitan is refused by the audit's own re-elaboration, not by this composition.
